_doc: Threshold reachability snapshot, captured by the source system's reachability harness (not included; it needs the original database). Each row runs the PRODUCTION comparison (same pairing, same text shapes the real call path uses) over the local corpus and reports count(rows >= threshold) + observed max. FAIL = 0 rows ever cross it (dead code that looks healthy). WARN = observed max within ~0.02 of the threshold (nearly dead).
